messages:
maya: Heads-up — can we swap facilitators for this week's platform-standards sync? I have a customer deep-dive on Thu 13:00 PT and won't be able to run the meeting.

ashwin: I can pick it up if someone quick-checks the agenda. What time are we aiming for?

maya: Thu 13:00 PT (same slot) — keeping it short, 45m. Main asks: RFC-2026 review, design lint rollout checklist, and a 10-min triage for urgent infra tags.

sophie: Thu 13 works for me. Can we add a 5-min note on the canary failover policy? Saw some flakiness in dev last night. :eyes:

jorge: +1 to the canary item. Also will need a short update on kernel selection for the runtime patch (2 slides).

ashwin: Cool. I'll facilitate. Who can lead RFC-2026 walk-through? maya, do you want to summarize or should I pull in the author?

maya: I can bullets it out in the doc, but ask @eva to give the author perspective — eva was writing it originally.

eva: I can do a 7-min run-through of the goals and rollbacks. I'll add the short TL;DR to the doc by EOD.

sophie: For the design lint rollout, can someone post the checklist? I remember we had a draft but not the rollout windows.

ashwin: Agenda draft — I'll paste quick template here so we can iterate:

```
1) Quick round (5m)
2) RFC-2026 review (15m) — author walk-through + Q/A
3) Design lint rollout checklist (10m) — owner: @sophie
4) Runtime kernel selection update (7m) — owner: @jorge
5) Triage items (8m) — quick decisions / owners
6) AOB / follow-ups (cancel if time) (0-5m)
```

ashwin: If that looks OK I'll lock calendar invite and add the doc link. Any objections to making this a recorded meeting? We might want to share with infra and product.

maya: Recording is fine. Can we also enable transcript? Helps async folks.

jorge: FYI infra may be short-staffed Thu — if kernel slides need infra detail, I can give high-level and follow-up with docs.

ashwin: Noted. Sophie, can you own the rollout checklist update before EOD tomorrow? We can slot extra time in the agenda if more discussion needed.

sophie: Yep, I'll update and add the rollout windows + risk matrix by tomorrow noon.

calendar-bot: Meeting created: "Platform Standards — Thu 13:00 PT" — link: https://calendar.example/meet/abc123 (recording enabled) :calendar:

ashwin: Thanks everyone — I'll send an invite and paste the doc link here once it's updated. Please add any pre-read links to the doc. :thumbsup:

maya: Appreciate the cover, @ashwin. If there's time in triage please call out any quick CRs that need immediate reviewers — I'll ping the app team.

eva: Added RFC-2026 short TL;DR to the doc and linked the draft PR. PR: https://git.example/rfcs/2026 — reviewers: @sophie @jorge.

ashwin: Great. Final check — volunteers for note-taking during the meeting? I can do initial notes but prefer someone else to own the action list.

sophie: I can take notes and own the action list for this one.

ashwin: Awesome. Locking facilitator: @ashwin, notes: @sophie, author run-through: @eva. See you Thu 13:00 PT.
